The '''Tythan military''' was a military force located in [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. It was composed of individuals of various species working for the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of their native system in locations of strategical importance, like the [[Fury Station]]. They worked occasionally with members of the [[Je'daii Order]].
